action.reason: Day 1 baseline establishment. Pendulum_lab is fundamental to our precision programme and must have solid baseline data before any comparative work can proceed. 12 trials will give sufficient data to characterize mean behaviour and variance under controlled lab conditions. This is methodological necessity, not hypothesis-driven—I need to know what 'normal' looks like for every instrument before I can trust it.

No anomalies apparent in day 1 data (mean 1.6698, spacing consistent with measurement resolution), but baseline solidity is the foundation for all downstream calibration. Proceeding methodically.
